title: Judge a writing aid by its items
statement: Judge a writing aid, such as a specification or prompt, by the items it leads to, against a no-aid baseline on the same requests, not by how it reads.
detail: Two ways of producing generation contracts, a fine-tuned small model and a deterministic compiler, were set up as a bake-off whose winner is whichever improves the downstream pass rate, retries, cost and failure mix on the same benchmark requests fed to the same generator, not whichever contract sounds better (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/deterministic_compiler/parallel_experiment_note.md`). It uses identical requests and generator settings and a no-helper baseline, and its rule is that the compiler wins by measured downstream outcomes (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/deterministic_compiler/README.md`).
against: At planning time the comparison had not run, and no result was found: '- No no-compiler baseline or compiler A/B harness has run.' (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/plans/2026-05-25-ib-pattern-compiler-prelaunch-revision.md`, line 61).

evidence.quote: The winner is not whichever contract sounds better. The winner is whichever path improves downstream InceptBench pass rate, retry count, cost, and failure distribution when feeding the same APUSH/APWH/APEuro benchmark requests into the same generator.
